content.title: Chapter 30 - ELECTIONS — Sec. 30-6. - Boundary changes.
content.summary:
Changes in voting precincts or voting districts or the establishment of new voting
               districts or voting precincts shall be completed not less than 90 days prior to any
               regular or special municipal election.
(Code 1981, § 11-6; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
